# ROVE S2 original platform and use records

## Project identity
- Project name: ROVE S2.
- Rear badge and presentation cover wording: ROVE S2.
- Video end frame wording: ROVE S2; Two seats. One weekend.
- Presentation cover phrase: Two seats. One weekend.
- Product: compact electric sports car; complete exterior and two-person cabin.
- Users: two adults; daily journeys, driving enjoyment and weekend short trips.
- Design horizon: contemporary or slightly ahead of the 2026 market.
- Design character: original whole-car identity, clean purposeful surfacing, considered lighting, modern materials and colours, credible everyday proportions.
- Supplied platform geometry: fixed design foundation.

## Coordinate frame
- Linear dimensions and coordinates: mm throughout.
- X: forward.
- Y: vehicle-left.
- Z: upward.
- Ground: Z=0.
- Shared origin: rear axle X=0.
- Platform scale and position: identical across all views and states.

## Platform and occupied volumes
| Record | Fixed value |
| --- | --- |
| Wheelbase | 2400 |
| Front track | 1450 |
| Rear track | 1450 |
| Rear wheel centres | (0,+/-725,290) |
| Front wheel centres | (2400,+/-725,290) |
| Tyres | Four; nominal outside diameter 580; width 195 |
| Rear drive envelope | X=-250..300; Y=-300..300; Z=250..550 |
| Battery envelope | X=450..1800; Y=-600..600; Z=180..330 |
| Front steering exclusions | Two; X=2050..2750; abs(Y)=500..960; Z=0..650 |
| Rear wheel exclusions | Two; X=-330..330; abs(Y)=590..860; Z=0..650 |
| Wheel/brake interfaces | Four |

- Battery and rear drive envelopes: fixed occupied volumes.
- Wheel exclusion occupants: relevant wheels, suspension and steering hardware.
- Battery, drive, cabin, luggage and body-solid locations: outside wheel exclusion volumes.

## Whole-car envelope and architecture
| Record | Fixed value |
| --- | --- |
| Closed car including unfolded mirrors | X=-750..3100; Y=-1020..1020; Z=0..1400 |
| Closed body lateral envelope, apart from mirrors and tyres | Y=+/-890 |
| Body underside ground clearance | At least 140; tyre and necessary wheel-hardware exception |
| Wheels | Four |
| Seats | Two front-facing adult seats, side by side |
| Side doors | Two, front-hinged |
| Roof | One fixed roof |
| Luggage access | One rear hatch |
| Luggage provision | Internal compartment behind the two seats |

## Occupants and cockpit
| Record | Fixed value |
| --- | --- |
| Nominal H points | (1000,+/-360,520) |
| Occupied seat/body envelopes | X=650..1300; abs(Y)=110..610; Z=350..1050 |
| Head envelopes | X=850..1100; abs(Y)=220..500; Z=1050..1280 |
| Roof interior above head envelopes | At least Z=1310 |
| Finished floor top | Z=350 |
| Driver pedal/foot zone | X=1550..1850; Y=+160..+560; Z=350..520 |
| Passenger foot zone | X=1550..1850; Y=-560..-160; Z=350..520 |
| Left-hand steering-wheel centre | (1500,360,760) |
| Steering-wheel nominal diameter | 320 |
| Steering wheels | One, driver side |
| Driver pedals | Two, inside driver foot zone |
| Seats and head restraints | Two of each |
| Belt paths | Two separate three-point paths |
| Driver information display | One |
| Drive selector | Reachable physical control |
| Hazard control | Physical control |

- Occupied and head envelopes: reserved clearance volumes.
- Relevant occupant-envelope contact surfaces: seat cushions, backrests and belts.
- Rigid console, body panels, roof and luggage: outside occupant clearance volumes.
- Passenger foot zone: foot accommodation.
- Physical control functions: turn signals; drive selection; hazards; emergency call; horn; front wipers; rear wipers; high beam; speed control.
- Physical control function count: nine.
- Cabin scope: seats, restraints, controls, driver display, trim and their spatial relationships.

## Forward sight references
| Record | Fixed value |
| --- | --- |
| E-L | (1000,360,1160) |
| E-R | (1000,-360,1160) |
| Target T for each eye | (3100,same Y,820) |
| Reserved strip X extent | 1200..2800 |
| Reserved strip Y extent | Eye Y +/-40 |
| Reserved strip Z extent | Sight-line height +/-30 |
| Line height at X | 1160 - 340 * (X - 1000) / 2100 |

- Sight-strip contents: air or transparent glazing.
- Opaque hood, pillars, dashboard and roof: outside reserved sight strips.
- Package relationships: both eye-to-target lines and adjacent body/glazing surfaces.

## Doors and entry
- Door hinge: front vertical axis on each side.
- Nominal outward opening: 60 degrees per door.
- Clear side aperture: at least 850 along X and 750 along Z.
- Sill top: at most Z=480.
- Opening dimensions: clear space within the aperture.
- Fixed entry references: floor, battery and seat positions.
- Resolved entry elements: sill thickness, hinge, latch and aperture.
- Entry location: S1 open staging apron.
- Entry actor: one adult entering the driver side; crouched posture available.

## Luggage
| Case | X length | Y width | Z height |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| L1 | 420 | 300 | 200 |
| L2 | 420 | 300 | 200 |

- Case construction: rigid.
- Case orientation: upright; long axes parallel to X.
- Case clearance: at least 10 at both X ends, both Y sides and overhead.
- Case support: direct floor contact available.
- Storage: two separate retained zones, simultaneously occupied.
- Separating structure: thickness recorded with the resolved compartment.
- Compartment location: behind seats, above rear drive, between rear wheel exclusions.
- Access: either case through the same opened rear hatch while the other case and both seats remain in place.
- Case envelopes and orientation: constant in storage and access depictions.

## Lighting and charging
| Equipment | Count and colour |
| --- | --- |
| Front headlamp assemblies | Two, white |
| Rear tail/brake assemblies | Two, red |
| Turn units | Four, amber |
| Rear reflectors | One red reflector per side; two total; passive |

| State | Active lighting |
| --- | --- |
| OFF | All active lamps unlit |
| DUSK | White front lamps and red tail lamps on; amber turns off |
| BRAKE | DUSK lighting with a labelled stronger red brake state in the same rear assemblies |

- Charge-flap side: vehicle-right.
- Charge-flap placement: within X=350..650 and Z=600..850.
- Charge-access states: flap closed; flap open with connector access.

## Colour and materials
| Application | Colour or material decision |
| --- | --- |
| Main exterior panels | Muted lagoon-blue; exact tone and proposed body material recorded in specification |
| Roof pillars and wheel centres | Dark graphite |
| Seats and cockpit surfaces | Warm charcoal |
| Decorative accents | Restrained copper-colour |
| Glazing | Transparent |
| Lamps | Functional colours from lighting records |

- Material application groups: body; roof/glazing; seat/trim; sills; wheels; luggage lining.
- Materials-board application count: seven, comprising body, roof, glazing, seat/trim, sills, wheels and luggage lining.
- Specification material fields: exact colour codes, textures and specific proposed material families.
- Connection details: sill-to-door seal; roof-to-glazing joint; luggage restraint.
- Overall body dimensions: selected within the fixed envelope and recorded in the specification.
- Development topics: physical packaging, entry, sight lines, sealing, luggage retention, thermal/electrical systems and road use.

## Sites
| Site | X extent | Y extent | Size | Conditions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P1 closed parking | -950..3350 | -1500..1500 | 4300 x 3000 | Flat ground; rear boundary X=-950; front edge open at X=3350 |
| S1 open staging apron | -1200..3550 | -2000..2000 | 4750 x 4000 | Open ground; adjacent area clear of obstacles |

- P1 vehicle position: original vehicle coordinates.
- P1 vehicle state: straight wheels, unfolded mirrors, closed doors and hatch, OFF lamps.
- P1 margin: at least 100 between every closed-car envelope edge and the corresponding bay edge.
- S1 uses: door entry, D1 departure and U1 luggage access.
- S1 occupancy boundary: whole car, opened doors/hatch and actors inside the rectangle.

## Use states
| State | Site and light | Car and occupants | Luggage and openings |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D1 departure | S1; dusk; DUSK lamps | Stationary car; two seated adults with belts | Both cases stowed; both doors and rear hatch closed |
| U1 luggage access, panel 1 | S1; daylight; OFF lamps | Stationary car | L1 lifted through rear hatch; L2 retained; both side doors closed |
| U1 luggage access, panel 2 | S1; daylight; OFF lamps | Same stationary car | L2 lifted through same rear hatch; L1 retained; both side doors closed |

- U1 hidden-case depiction: cutaway or inset available.
- Open hatch height: below Z=2100; opening above closed-car height 1400 available.
- Open hatch footprint: inside S1.
- U1 architecture: one shared compartment and hatch across both panels.

## Design continuity
- Shared vehicle record: platform rules, integrated package, resolved exterior, dimensions, cockpit, doors, storage and CMF decisions.
- Refinement record: explicit labels and consistent propagation across affected work.
- Image records: complete separate boards or views with legible constituent panels.
- Presentation basis: the delivered vehicle design and the same nominal platform and use records throughout.

steps.userMessage:
ROVE S2 | A compact electric sports car for two

We are developing ROVE S2 for two people who enjoy driving and use the same car for daily journeys and weekends away. Design the complete exterior and cabin around our supplied electric platform: four wheels, two side-by-side seats, left-hand drive, two front-hinged side doors, a fixed roof and one rear luggage hatch. The design should feel contemporary or slightly ahead of the 2026 market, with purposeful surfaces and a clear relationship between the exterior, door openings and cockpit. Print "ROVE S2" on the rear badge and presentation cover, and "Two seats. One weekend." on the video end frame and presentation cover.

All dimensions are in mm. X points forward, Y vehicle-left and Z upward from ground; the rear axle is X=0. Wheelbase is 2400, both tracks are 1450, and all four tyres are 580 in outside diameter and 195 wide. The battery occupies X=450..1800, Y=-600..600, Z=180..330; the rear drive occupies X=-250..300, Y=-300..300, Z=250..550. The closed car, with mirrors unfolded, fits X=-750..3100, Y=-1020..1020, Z=0..1400. Body solids other than mirrors and tyres stay within Y=+/-890, with at least 140 ground clearance. Retain the supplied wheel exclusions, occupant and foot volumes, steering position and sight strips. The two H points are (1000,+/-360,520), the finished floor is Z=350, and the roof interior above the head envelopes is at least Z=1310. Each door opens to a labelled nominal 60 degrees, with a clear aperture at least 850 along X by 750 along Z and a sill top at most Z=480. Provide physical controls for turn signals, drive selection, hazards, emergency call, horn, front wipers, rear wipers, high beam and speed control. Carry L1 and L2 together behind the seats: each rigid case is 420 x 300 x 200, upright with its long axis parallel to X, with at least 10 clearance at each end, each side and above. Either case must pass through the same rear hatch while the other remains retained. Use muted lagoon-blue exterior panels, dark graphite pillars and wheel centres, warm charcoal seating and cockpit surfaces, and restrained copper-colour accents; select exact tones and specific material families in the opening specification.

Audience: our product lead, exterior and interior design teams, and packaging engineers, for the whole-car design decision and the next development brief.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed platform, occupant, lighting, access and use-state records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. sites-and-cases.en.md contains the P1 and S1 site rectangles and the separate L1 and L2 case records. platform-reference.png is the constraint image for platform hard points, occupied volumes and sight strips. cases-identity.png is the identity image for the two existing rigid cases and their dimensions. weekend-apron-reference.png is the atmosphere reference for a weekend roadside stop on an open apron.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page hard-point and state specification, recording platform coordinates, chosen overall dimensions, nine physical control functions, OFF/DUSK/BRAKE states, fixed wording, exact colour codes and proposed materials for body, roof/glazing, seat/trim, sills, wheels and luggage lining
2. One integrated package board with plan and longitudinal sections, four wheel/brake interfaces, occupied and excluded volumes, both eye-to-target lines, two seat and belt arrangements, door apertures and simultaneous L1/L2 storage
3. One exterior orthographic board with front, side and rear views, repeating the specification's wheelbase, tracks and chosen overall dimensions
4. One front three-quarter exterior view of the resolved car
5. One rear three-quarter exterior view with the ROVE S2 badge
6. One cockpit board with a two-seat perspective, driver-control detail and labelled locations for all nine physical control functions
7. One driver-entry board on S1, with an adult entering, a 60-degree door opening and dimensioned clear aperture, sill, hinge and latch details
8. One U1 luggage-access board with two panels, one for L1 removal with L2 retained and one for L2 removal with L1 retained, including case clearances, divider thickness and the hatch opening path
9. One materials and connections board with seven material applications and three enlarged details: sill-to-door seal, roof-to-glazing joint and luggage restraint, repeating the specification's colour codes and material names
10. One lighting board with matched front and rear views for each of OFF, DUSK and BRAKE, six panels in total
11. One vehicle-right charge-access board with closed-flap and open connector-access views, two panels in total
12. One use-scene board with P1 closed parking and D1 dusk departure on S1, two panels in total, repeating the site and state labels
13. One 10-second video with an exterior orbit, cockpit view and D1 departure tableau, ending with ROVE S2 and Two seats. One weekend.
14. One presentation document of at least 10 pages, reusing the specification, package, exterior, cockpit, entry, luggage, materials, lighting, charge-access and use-scene work

Acceptance:
- The specification, package board, orthographic board and presentation repeat wheelbase 2400, front and rear tracks 1450 and the same chosen overall dimensions. The package board locates the battery, rear drive, wheel exclusions, H points, floor, steering centre and both sight strips at the supplied coordinates; its clear roof interior reaches at least Z=1310 above the head envelopes.
- The orthographic board, both exterior perspectives, cockpit, entry, luggage, lighting, charge-access and use-scene boards, video and presentation carry the same body surfaces, glazing, wheels, two front-hinged doors and rear hatch. The rear perspective carries ROVE S2; the video end frame and presentation cover carry ROVE S2 and Two seats. One weekend.
- The cockpit and package boards contain two head restraints, separate three-point belt paths, two driver pedals, a driver information display and a steering wheel centred at (1500,360,760) with nominal diameter 320. The cockpit board locates all nine physical control functions named in the letter. The entry board labels 60 degrees, clear opening dimensions of at least 850 X by 750 Z, and sill top at most Z=480; the car, open door and entering adult fit inside S1.
- The package and U1 boards preserve both 420 x 300 x 200 upright cases with long axes parallel to X, separate retained zones, at least 10 clearance at each end, each side and above, and a stated separator thickness. U1 shows each case passing through the same hatch while the other stays in place, with both side doors closed and OFF lamps; the open hatch remains below Z=2100 and inside S1. D1 and the presentation retain both cases in those same zones.
- The lighting board labels OFF, DUSK and BRAKE and uses two white front assemblies, two red rear tail/brake assemblies, four amber turn units and two passive rear red reflectors. OFF leaves active lamps unlit; DUSK lights the white fronts and red tails with amber turns off; BRAKE adds a labelled stronger red state in the same rear assemblies. The charge-access board locates the vehicle-right flap within X=350..650 and Z=600..850 in both panels. P1 uses straight wheels, unfolded mirrors, closed openings and OFF lamps with at least 100 to each bay edge; D1 uses two belted adults, closed openings and DUSK lamps on S1.
- The materials board and presentation repeat the specification's exact colour codes and seven material applications, including the lagoon-blue, graphite, charcoal and copper assignments. The 10-second video preserves those finishes and the delivered cockpit and D1 state. The presentation contains at least 10 pages and repeats the chosen dimensions, OFF/DUSK/BRAKE labels, P1, S1, D1 and U1 alongside the corresponding earlier work.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
